q.en: Do you provide ATO-compliant tax invoices and $20M public liability insurance for corporate events?

a.en: Yes. Every corporate quote and invoice clearly shows the 10% GST breakdown in AUD, and all partner suppliers are vetted for ABN and public liability compliance.

q.en: How does guest registration and table seating work for 200+ corporate attendees?

a.en: Attendees RSVP online with their dietary needs and receive a personal QR entry pass showing their assigned table number for rapid door check-in.
